visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern indoor studio with a gray marble wall and a prominent red Supreme-branded locker in the background. A man with black hair, wearing glasses, a black baseball cap, and a black t-shirt, sits at a wooden desk typing on a tablet with a keyboard case. A woman with short blonde hair, dressed in a denim jacket and white top, stands beside him holding a yellow envelope. Several anime figurines are positioned on the desk in front of the man. (2) The man looks up from his tablet and speaks to the woman while gesturing with his right hand in a waving, dismissive motion to indicate a rejection. The woman looks at him with a neutral expression as he continues to talk and then refocuses on his screen. (3) The woman shrugs her denim jacket off her shoulders to reveal her white tank top more clearly. The man instantly looks up with widened eyes and an enthusiastic expression. He quickly reaches down to pull a white paper contract and a pen from under his tablet. The woman then leans over the desk to sign the document while the man watches with a smile.

[Subtitle]: I'm sorry, but we're not accepting new members at the moment. (3) [Subtitle]: 我們剛好缺一位. [Subtitle]: We just happen to be missing one person. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個合約剛好準備好了. [Subtitle]: And just like that, the contract is ready! (5) [Subtitle]: 現在就簽嗎 可以可以. [Subtitle]: Sign it right now? Oh yes, absolutely!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in Mandarin with a clear, polite tone, inquiring about a position; it is backed by a bright synth-pop music bed featuring steady electronic percussion. The track has a moderate tempo and high fidelity, typical of studio production. (2) A male voice enters with a conversational and slightly apologetic tone, explaining a lack of vacancies. The background music continues steadily without interruption, and the acoustic floor remains exceptionally clean with no environmental noise. (3) A sudden 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a shift in the male voice, which becomes high-pitched and eager. Sounds of paper rustling and light percussive desk taps are audible as the speakers transition to signing a contract. The upbeat electronic music maintains its energy until the final cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic short designed to satirize hiring biases, using a visual gag where a man's refusal to hire a candidate is immediately reversed when she reveals her physical attractiveness.
